# API changelog v1.1.0

Changes to the stable and beta API since v1.0.0. Experimental operations are outside the compatibility guarantee and are listed separately below.

## Changes

### GET /flows
-  endpoint deprecated
-  added the optional property `items/items/description` to the response with the `200` status
-  response property `items/items/updatedAt` deprecated

### POST /flows
- :warning: removed the enum value `INACTIVE` of the request property `status`
-  added the optional property `description` to the response with the `201` status
-  response property `updatedAt` deprecated

### DELETE /flows/{flowId}
-  endpoint added

### GET /flows/{flowId}
-  added the optional property `description` to the response with the `200` status
-  response property `updatedAt` deprecated

## Deprecations

| Kind | Name | Sunset | Migration guide |
|---|---|---|---|
| field | `Flow.updatedAt` | 2027-06-30 | <https://orcon.example/docs/deprecations/updated-at> |
| operation | GET /flows | 2027-06-30 | <https://orcon.example/docs/deprecations/list-flows> |

## Experimental

Experimental operations need the `Orcon-Experimental` header and can change or disappear in any release.

| Operation | Operation id | Summary | Since the previous release |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET /probes | `listProbes` | List probes | existing |
| GET /probes/{probeId} | `getProbe` | Get a probe | new |
